idea_summary: A multi-tenant marketplace platform enabling independent sellers to manage product listings, buyers to securely checkout with atomic inventory reservation and idempotent payment processing, and administrators to govern dispute resolution and auditable refunds.

functional_requirements.statement: Sellers must manage product listings with strict ownership enforcement preventing cross-tenant modifications.
acceptance_criteria: System returns HTTP 403 Forbidden when a seller attempts to modify or delete a listing owned by another seller.
All product modifications verify seller identity from authenticated JWT claims against the product's seller_id field.

functional_requirements.statement: Buyers must place orders with idempotent payment processing to prevent duplicate charges under retry scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Orders API requires a unique Idempotency-Key header for checkout and payment requests.
Submitting the same idempotency key within 24 hours returns the cached transaction response without double-charging.

functional_requirements.statement: System must guarantee atomic inventory reservation and consistency during concurrent checkout attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory decrements occur within an ACID transaction with row-level locks or optimistic version checks.
Concurrent checkout attempts exceeding available stock fail with HTTP 409 Conflict without inventory overselling.

functional_requirements.statement: Administrators must process order refunds with an immutable, append-only audit trail capturing administrative rationale.
acceptance_criteria: Every refund generates an immutable audit record containing admin ID, order ID, amount, timestamp, and justification reason.
Non-admin users cannot access or execute refund endpoints.

functional_requirements.statement: System must explicitly handle and reject invalid or failed payment attempts while preserving consistent order state.
acceptance_criteria: Failed payment gateway responses transition order status to PAYMENT_FAILED and release reserved inventory immediately.
Rejection reasons are logged and returned to the client with appropriate error schema.

non_functional_requirements.statement: API Gateway must throttle incoming traffic to mitigate abuse and protect downstream microservices.
non_functional_requirements.target: Rate limit of 100 requests per minute per IP for public endpoints and 500 requests per minute per authenticated user token.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Automated load testing with Locust injecting burst traffic and validating HTTP 429 Too Many Requests responses.

non_functional_requirements.statement: End-to-end checkout latency must remain performant under peak load conditions.
non_functional_requirements.target: 99th percentile response time under 350ms for order placement at 1000 requests per second.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Distributed performance testing using k6 measuring p99 latency against production-like staging environment.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Audit logs and refund transaction records must remain tamper-evident and highly durable.
non_functional_requirements.target: 100% append-only durability with zero record mutability and 99.999999999% cloud storage durability.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Automated integrity verification script and database permission audits ensuring REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE on audit tables.

architecture_components.name: API Gateway and Security Enforcement Proxy
responsibilities: Terminates TLS, validates JWT tokens, enforces RBAC policies, and executes rate limiting per client IP and user identity.

architecture_components.name: Product Catalog and Listing Service
responsibilities: Handles product catalog CRUD operations and strictly validates seller ownership before permitting updates.

architecture_components.name: Order and Inventory Management Engine
responsibilities: Orchestrates checkout state machine, manages atomic inventory allocation, and prevents overselling.

architecture_components.name: Payment and Idempotency Gateway
responsibilities: Integrates with third-party payment processors, tracks idempotency keys, and handles payment retries and failures safely.

architecture_components.name: Admin Refund and Audit Trail Ledger
responsibilities: Executes partial/full refunds and writes immutable records to the audit ledger upon admin action.

data_entities.name: UserAccount
data_entities.purpose: Stores user profiles, credentials, assigned roles (SELLER, BUYER, ADMIN), and tenant identification.

data_entities.name: ProductListing
data_entities.purpose: Maintains product details, pricing, available stock quantity, and owning seller ID.

data_entities.name: Order
data_entities.purpose: Tracks buyer order status, item line items, total amounts, and lifecycle timestamps.

data_entities.name: InventoryReservation
data_entities.purpose: Maintains row locks and temporary reservation status during checkout workflows.

data_entities.name: PaymentTransaction
data_entities.purpose: Records payment attempts, idempotency keys, gateway references, and transaction outcomes.

data_entities.name: RefundAuditLog
data_entities.purpose: Immutable ledger of refund actions, issuing admin identity, refund amounts, and administrative rationale.

api_operations.purpose: Creates a new product listing under the authenticated seller's account.
Updates an existing product listing after validating seller ownership.
Initiates an order checkout with inventory reservation and idempotent payment execution.
Executes a refund for a specified order and appends an entry to the audit log.

tests.description: Verify that a seller cannot update or delete another seller's product listing (expects 403 Forbidden).
Verify payment idempotency by re-submitting order checkout with the same Idempotency-Key header.
Simulate concurrent checkouts on the last available item in inventory to ensure no double-allocation occurs.
Verify that non-admin tokens are rejected when attempting to call the refund endpoint (expects 403 Forbidden).
Verify failed payment handling releases inventory locks and marks order status as PAYMENT_FAILED.
Validate API Gateway rate-limiting rejects requests exceeding 100 req/min for unauthenticated clients.

obligation_coverage.design_response: Enforced at API Gateway and Product Catalog Service by verifying seller_id in JWT claims matches the listing owner before executing updates.
Enforced via Payment and Idempotency Gateway caching unique Idempotency-Key values in Redis/PostgreSQL within an atomic transaction.
Enforced via dedicated Admin Refund and Audit Trail Ledger storing immutable records with admin ID, timestamp, and rationale.
Enforced via Order and Inventory Management Engine utilizing transactional isolation with SELECT FOR UPDATE row locking.
Covered by automated test suite simulating payment gateway rejection, asserting status transition and inventory unlock.

assumptions.statement: Payment gateway webhook events or synchronous responses are the primary source of truth for payment failure transitions.
Refunds require manual administrator approval rather than automated seller-initiated self-service refunds in Phase 1.
